# Measuring friction

<!-- STEP id="reading" -->
Pull with slowly increasing force, and note the reading when the block just starts to move. If the block then moves at a steady velocity, the net force on it is zero. So the reading is about equal to the force of friction.

<!-- STEP id="compare" -->
The reading is smallest on the surface where the coins went farthest.

**Smaller friction: the velocity falls more slowly, and the object goes farther before it stops.**
